queries:
WITH item_averages AS (
    SELECT
        ili.order_item_id,
        c.town_city AS town,
        AVG(ili.product_price) AS average_price,
        AVG(CAST(ili.derived_product_cost AS REAL) / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS average_ratio
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
    JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number
    JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
    JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city
),
town_averages AS (
    SELECT
        town,
        AVG(average_price) AS average_price,
        AVG(average_ratio) AS average_ratio
    FROM item_averages
    GROUP BY town
),
cross_town_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_ratio) AS average_ratio
    FROM town_averages
)
SELECT
    t.town,
    t.average_price,
    t.average_ratio,
    t.average_ratio - x.average_ratio AS ratio_above_average
FROM town_averages AS t
CROSS JOIN cross_town_average AS x
WHERE t.average_ratio > x.average_ratio

WITH item_averages AS (
    SELECT
        ili.order_item_id,
        c.town_city,
        AVG(ili.product_price) AS average_price,
        AVG(CAST(ili.derived_product_cost AS REAL) / ili.derived_total_cost) AS average_ratio
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
    JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id
    JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city
),
town_averages AS (
    SELECT
        town_city,
        AVG(average_price) AS average_price,
        AVG(average_ratio) AS average_ratio
    FROM item_averages
    GROUP BY town_city
)
SELECT
    town_city,
    average_price,
    average_ratio,
    average_ratio - (SELECT AVG(average_ratio) FROM town_averages) AS ratio_above_average
FROM town_averages
WHERE average_ratio > (SELECT AVG(average_ratio) FROM town_averages)

WITH per_order_item AS (
    SELECT
        oi.order_item_id,
        c.town_city AS town,
        AVG(ili.product_price) AS average_price,
        AVG(1.0 * ili.derived_product_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS average_ratio
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
    JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number
    JOIN Order_Items AS oi
        ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id
       AND oi.order_id = i.order_id
    JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
    JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    GROUP BY oi.order_item_id, c.town_city
),
per_town AS (
    SELECT
        town,
        AVG(average_price) AS average_price,
        AVG(average_ratio) AS average_ratio
    FROM per_order_item
    GROUP BY town
),
cross_town AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_ratio) AS average_ratio
    FROM per_town
)
SELECT
    pt.town,
    pt.average_price,
    pt.average_ratio,
    pt.average_ratio - ct.average_ratio AS ratio_above_average
FROM per_town AS pt
CROSS JOIN cross_town AS ct
WHERE pt.average_ratio > ct.average_ratio

WITH item_averages AS (
    SELECT
        ili.order_item_id,
        c.town_city,
        AVG(ili.product_price) AS average_price,
        AVG(ili.derived_product_cost / ili.derived_total_cost) AS average_ratio
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
    JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number
    JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
    JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL
      AND ili.product_price IS NOT NULL
      AND ili.derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL
      AND ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL
      AND ili.derived_total_cost <> 0
    GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city
),
town_averages AS (
    SELECT
        town_city,
        AVG(average_price) AS average_price,
        AVG(average_ratio) AS average_ratio
    FROM item_averages
    GROUP BY town_city
)
SELECT
    town_city,
    average_price,
    average_ratio,
    average_ratio - (SELECT AVG(average_ratio) FROM town_averages) AS ratio_above_average
FROM town_averages
WHERE average_ratio > (SELECT AVG(average_ratio) FROM town_averages)
